title: Almost-wise output density
statement: Let $k,n$ be positive integers with $k\le n$, and let $a,b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$. The almost-wise output density is the pushforward, under the almost-wise transform, of the deterministic small-bias density associated with these parameters.
caveat: The payload does not define the small-bias input or density, so the starting density cannot be specified self-containedly.
